requirementSummary: The ticket requests that the DX Coil Height be updated immediately after each edit, but also states that the DX Coil Height must never be updated after an edit.
businessRules: DX Coil Height must update immediately after every edit.
DX Coil Height must never update after an edit.
ambiguities: The ticket contains contradictory requirements: one mandates immediate update after every edit, while the other mandates never updating after an edit.
It is unclear what constitutes an "edit" in this context.
